title: Bridge Envelope v1
description: Canonical bridge envelope contract governing all frontend<->backend traffic. Builds on rig.relay.bridge_message.v1 with explicit trace_id, frontend_session_id, backend_session_id, protocol_version, and refusal/error envelope. Content-light: no raw paths, secrets, prompts, or private file contents cross the bridge.

trace_id.description: End-to-end trace identifier surviving frontend -> bridge -> backend -> projection.

parent_message_id.description: When present, this message responds to or correlates with a prior message_id.

frontend_session_id.description: Frontend-originated session identifier stable across reconnections.

backend_session_id.description: Backend-assigned session identifier set during handshake completion.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version for contract compatibility checks.

projection_sequence.description: Monotonic projection sequence. Frontend ignores stale sequences.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of envelope creation.

idempotency_key.description: When present, duplicate messages with the same key must not execute twice.

payload_schema.description: Schema identifier for the payload field (e.g., rig.relay.frontend_intent.v1).

payload.description: Kind-specific data. Content-light: no raw paths, tokens, keys, codes, prompts, or file contents.

redaction_status.description: Hard invariant: every envelope is content_light.

refusal.description: Refusal envelope when backend refuses a message. Present only on kind=error or intent_result with refused status.
